title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-rpj4: edhoc test match mismatch in test_invalid_method_is_rejected_before_dh
description: The test at tests/crypto/test_edhoc.py:454 uses match="METHOD_CORR" but process_message_1 raises "Method mismatch: initiator sent method=1, responder expects method=0" after validating method_corr=4. The commit correctly changed the test's _sequence value from 0 (valid method) to 4 (invalid method), but did not update the match string to match the actual error message. Should be match="Method mismatch" or similar. Note: this test also has a pre-existing NameError (edhoc_module not defined at line 451) which is a separate pre-existing issue.
